name: qa_pingpong
title: OS-INSFX-FX2, the Ping-Pong effect module (modules/effects/pingpong, kind 2, a WIDENS effect of ABI 1.12) as a track insert from the console: loaded from the card, bound with `diag ins`, heard on headphones (the first echo hard left, the next hard right, on the grid of the pattern), its tail ends, and its cost read with `diag bench insert` (bench image; BLOCKED until the bench takes a state over 512 bytes, see the last step). Console only: the insert is NOT saved (S3), and the console has no insert parameter verb, so the Sync, Time, Feedback, Low cut, High cut, Mix and Width sweeps and the factory presets are a hand check once the Mixer's INSERTS page and the parameter page exist (S4, S5, A8, A9). Needs an image with OS-INSFX-ABI2 A4 (before it the OS never calls render_st: silence) and A3 (before it get_clock is a 120 BPM stub: the echo does not follow the tempo) and modules/effects/pingpong.tmod on the card (the build's modules/pingpong.tmod, copied by the tester). Reset the unit first so that pingpong is the only effect module loaded. Writes nothing to the card. Leaves no insert bound

steps.say: OS-INSFX-FX2, rows QA-GLB-220, 221, 222 and 223 of docs/qa/catalogue/global.md (a unit step is named by the row id its note begins with; QA-GLB-221 and 222 are host tests). Put modules/effects/pingpong.tmod on the card, reset the unit so that no other effect module is loaded, and open the project the run is about (the Dense8 song of OS-DENSE, or any project with a sounding track 1 that plays hits with gaps, a snare or a short sample, at the song's tempo). The insert is console-bound: it is lost on save and on reload until the project record lands (slice S3). The default setting is Sync `3` (a dotted eighth), Feedback 45 %, Low cut 120 Hz, High cut 6 kHz, Mix 35 %, Width 100 %: on headphones track 1 must have an echo that goes left, right, left, each darker than the last, on the grid of the pattern

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
QA-GLB-220: the packed module passes the loader on the unit (ABI 1.12: the stereo descriptor, the labels and the presets are read and checked)
QA-GLB-220: loaded, version 1.0.0; `mod` also says where its hot part runs (the SRAM_L slab or SDRAM): read it against the hot size of the build (about 1.5 KB)
QA-GLB-220: bound to track 1, slot 1, with its default parameters (a 177 KB state: a bind that finds no room in the SDRAM module region is refused, NeedState)
QA-GLB-220: the insert runs and its measured cycles and share of the block are on the line (the spec's estimate was 2.7 % with the adapter, this module's is about 3.5 % [est]); the state is in SDRAM
QA-GLB-220: the load with the insert on; underruns 0; read it against the same project with no insert
QA-GLB-220: nothing was forced to dry

steps.say: QA-GLB-220, by ear on HEADPHONES: track 1 has a dotted-eighth echo (Sync 3): the first echo hard left, the next hard right, then left again, each a little darker than the last, **on the grid of the pattern** (with A3 on the image; before it the tempo is a 120 BPM stub). Change the song's tempo while it plays: the echoes follow the new tempo with a short smooth cross-fade and no click. The dry track and the other tracks are unchanged. Then `ins bypass 1 1 on`: the clean sound returns with no click

steps.note: QA-GLB-220: bypass is the host's one-block ramp to dry
QA-GLB-220: off resets the module (shutdown, init) and the effect starts from silence: no thump, no old echo

QA-GLB-220: a few seconds after the stop the echoes have rung out (at 45 % feedback they are gone in about a second and the line is silent a second later); a `tail` word may still show until the host's own rule (2 s of exact zeros) ends it: read it again after 3 s more
QA-GLB-220: no `tail` word: the module returned 0 once its whole line was zeros
QA-GLB-220: the render figure is a stopped transport's, with the ping-pong bound and idle

expect: BENCH insert_st \d+ 64 avg \d+ max \d+ \(pingpong, adapter \d+ cycles \(\d+\.\d%\) peak \d+\)
steps.note: QA-GLB-223: BLOCKED until the bench takes a state over 512 bytes (bench.cpp copies the state to a 512-byte stack buffer: for this module the stereo rows would time the built-in identity and the label would not say pingpong, and the mono row says `too big to copy`): once a bench change is in, bench image (`-DO3OS_BENCH=ON`), transport stopped, pingpong the only loaded effect: `insert_st_effect` is render_st() of 64 frames alone at the defaults, `insert_st` the whole stereo insert with the adapter, `insert_effect_mod` (the mono rows) the first MOD target, Feedback, swept every block. Quote min, avg and max in cycles and as a share of the 261,225-cycle block against the 4 points (10.4k cycles) a WIDENS insert may take (docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX2 rows): above it the slice stops for the maintainer

steps.say: QA-GLB-223: copy the BENCH lines (min / avg / max) into docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX2 PING-PONG rows, and into the module's README; the cap of four instances stays or is lowered from them (spec R2: four lines are 708 KB of the 768 KiB module region)
